pattern: One-week spike

pattern: Historical hotspot, since resolved
note: Visible in the 12-month chart; useful for back-testing

pattern: Slow climb at one facility and diagnosis
note: Rises a little more each week; the trend check should catch it

pattern: Wave across exactly three facilities in one borough
facilities: The Mount Sinai Hospital; Lenox Hill Hospital; NYU Langone Tisch Hospital

pattern: Specialty hospital, its main diagnosis

pattern: Children's hospital
note: Asthma at a children's hospital

pattern: Small facility outside the city, all diagnoses
note: Low volume overall, so only the facility as a whole should qualify

pattern: Decoy: small rise at a large facility
note: About three extra admissions; within normal ups and downs

pattern: Decoy: tiny facility doubles
note: Double, but only about three extra admissions; blocked by the minimum volume

pattern: Decoy: spike that ended before the window
note: Over five weeks ago; nothing is elevated now

pattern: Decoy: a single busy day
note: One day cannot make a 28-day hotspot

pattern: Decoy: two-week bump that faded
note: Ended two weeks before the window; the previous-28-days check should not fire

pattern: Same diagnosis at three facilities of one health system, in three boroughs
facilities: Long Island Jewish Medical Center; Lenox Hill Hospital; Staten Island University Hospital - North

pattern: Same diagnosis at two facilities of one health system

pattern: One large and two small facilities of one health system

pattern: Hotspot at an out-of-network facility
note: Network status is a label only; it must not change detection
